response.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(CASE WHEN sp.boxy IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz != 0 THEN CAST(sp.boxy AS FLOAT) / CAST(sp.boxz AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM scanspatial sp JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source_avg AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio), SUM(ss.record_count), AVG(ss.record_count - csa.avg_count) FROM source_stats ss CROSS JOIN cross_source_avg csa WHERE ss.record_count > csa.avg_count
